Removing

Refitting

Position the vehicle on a lift.

Raise the vehicle.

Op. 4450B08 RIGHT REAR WHEEL R R

[Left or right]

1. Release the handbrake cable.

2. Remove the retaining clip and unscrew the brake fluid pipe fitting.

3. Unscrew the brake calliper bolts.

4. Remove the brake caliper.

Refitting

Removing

Fit the brake calliper in its seat and tighten the bolts.

Fit the handbrake cable in its seat.

Tighten the brake fluid pipe fitting and do up the retaining clip.

Top up the brake fluid level and bleed the system.

Op. 4450B08 RIGHT REAR WHEEL R R

[Left or right]

Remove the vehicle from the lift.
